summary: Example generated collection layout for myos interfaces: modules myos_facts.py and myos_interfaces.py, plus module_utils/network/myos with argspec, config, facts and utils packages.
questions: What files does the resource module builder create in a collection?
Where do argspec and facts files go for a resource module?

answer_card.title: Generated collection layout
answer_card.answer_md:
For `myos` / `interfaces`:
```text
plugins/
  modules/
    myos_facts.py
    myos_interfaces.py
  module_utils/network/myos/
    argspec/{facts,interfaces}/
    config/interfaces/
    facts/facts.py, facts/interfaces/
    utils/utils.py
```
Plus `docs/`, `playbooks/`, `roles/`, `README.md`, `LICENSE.txt`.
